description: Prepare a client invoice from a saved ExpenseBot report without creating it. Reads canonical report rows, allocates a unique invoice number, verifies the client ledger identity and advance, and returns exact totals plus a short-lived preparationId. Call this first, show the preview to the user, then call create_client_invoice after explicit confirmation. It reserves the invoice number and preview for 30 minutes but creates no invoice, document, Income row, email, or payment.

advanceApplied.description: Verified client advance to apply against this invoice.

billToEmail.description: Optional client email printed on the invoice. This does not send email.

clientAddress.description: Optional billing address printed in the invoice's Bill To section.

clientName.description: Full client or business name shown on the invoice.

customLineItems.description: Optional fee/service lines. They are taxed but never marked up.

amount.description: Positive amount for this fee or service line in the invoice currency.

description.description: User-approved fee or service description shown on the invoice.

invoiceNumber.description: Optional custom invoice number. ExpenseBot allocates one when omitted.

issueDate.description: Calendar-valid invoice date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

markupPct.description: Markup applied only to rebilled expense rows.

mentionSupportingReceipts.description: When true, note on the invoice that supporting receipts are available.

paymentTerms.description: Invoice due terms. Defaults to the client's billing profile or net30.

receiptIds.description: Optional exact report receipt IDs. Defaults to every current report expense.

reportId.description: Saved ExpenseBot report ID to invoice.

taxLabel.description: Tax label such as HST, GST, or VAT.

taxPct.description: Tax percentage applied after markup and custom line items; use 0 for no tax.

name: prepare_client_invoice
